observed_interactions: The progression screen lists five rounds in order, each with an 'After <year> <season>' timing label.
Each round row carries a 'Held' status marker; rounds already won show a WIN marker (Rounds 1-2 on 2026-07-17 235625).
A NEXT label and a decreasing turn countdown render on the screen (12 turn(s) on 2026-07-17 235625, 11 turn(s) on 2026-07-18 161325).
unresolved_questions: Confirm whether the five Unity Cup round timings are fixed per run or vary by run.
Confirm whether the WIN marker replaces the Held marker or renders alongside it on a completed round.
